statements.t: When we acquire turnaround or start-up operations, we expect that our combined metrics may be impacted.
We expect these metrics to vary from period to period based upon the maturity of the operations within our portfolio.

We have generally experienced lower occupancy rates and higher costs at our senior living communities and lower census and higher costs at our home health and hospice agencies for recently acquired operations; as a result, we generally anticipate lower and/or fluctuating consolidated and segment margins during years of acquisition growth.

We believe that our existing cash, cash generated through operations, and access to available borrowing capacity under our Amended Credit Agreement, will be sufficient to provide adequate liquidity for the next twelve months for both our operating activities and for opportunities of acquisition growth.
“Our third quarter results are consistent with our full-year guidance and put us on track for a successful conclusion to the year.
“Each of these additions was carefully selected based on its considerable long-term potential and we expect them to positively impact the organization and local communities for years to come.

More complete information is contained in the Company’s Form 10-Q for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, which will be filed with the SEC and will be available to be viewed on the Company’s website at www.pennantgroup.com.
